title: adapter.json
description: An adapter declares which skills it augments and the slot content it provides. The renderer fills matching slots in generic skill bodies and prunes the rest.

skillsDir.description: Harness adapters only: directory the per-skill links go in, e.g. '.claude/skills'.

linkBase.description: Harness adapters only: relative link target base from skillsDir to the rendered skills, e.g. '../../.ai/skills'.

augments.description: Skill ids this adapter contributes slot content to.

slots.description: slotName -> path (relative to the adapter dir) of the fragment that fills it. Slot names are '<axis>.<key>'.

tiers.description: Optional skills this adapter adds, and the tier each joins.
